name: motion-diagonal-wipe
title: Diagonal Wipe
description: Nội dung đứng yên, một mép chéo 45° quét từ góc dưới trái lên góc trên phải để lộ ra.

moworks.author: moworks

options.angle: degrees of the gradient (45: from the lower left to the upper right)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Still content revealed by a 45° edge travelling from the lower-left corner to the upper-right: edge offset 0 → 145 % (of ~232 px on a 200×120 box; clip-path polygon) in 680 ms power4.inOut (easeInOutQuint); a 2 px light line rides the edge while it crosses. Exit: fade 320 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.68 s) · angle (45°) · from: góc bắt đầu (dưới trái) · ease (power4.inOut).
